analysis_options.entrypoint: Oracle side builds the raw universal Action tree through ActionDatabase::universalAction and derives an unfiltered clone via the public group API (setGroup("all") + setCurrent("all")); Rust side drives the identical child sequence of build_default_pipeline (the construction behind ActionDatabase::set_default_actions). Both sides perform the merge-group children assignhigh..mergetype in tree order through the exact Action::perform / ActionRestartGroup::perform_child boundary, catching the exception/panic channel per child (LowlevelError catch vs catch_unwind).
analysis_options.prestate: One BlockBasic b0 with three ops in SeqNum order: r0 a1=COPY(const4:5) with a1 a 4-byte stack:0x100 output created through the production newVarnodeOut path (funcdata_varnode.cc:104) with the queryProperties addrtied|mapped tail cleared (mirroring the raw-bank Rust creation path); r1 s1=SUBPIECE(const8:0x11223344, const1:0) with s1 a second 4-byte stack:0x100 output on the same path with the tail cleared; r2 t2=INT_ADD(s1, const4:7) with t2 a unique-space output. All three carry the int4 base Datatype. At mergerequired the exact-location cluster {a1,s1} is ungated (no addrtied member), so the one and only mergeAddrTied pass skips it; highs stay singletons. After markimplied marks s1 implied, the fixture installs addrtied|mapped on a1 (the arrival timing ActionDynamicSymbols setSymbolProperties produces in the real regression, visible as Varnode::mapped in the panic dump), then drives mergeadjacent and mergetype.
analysis_options.observation: 17 fixed-order UTF-8 lines: envelope, seq (11 merge-group child names), pre projection (per-varnode in/wr/ex/im/at/hi for a1,s1,t2), 10 act lines (name, perform return res, exception channel exc) with the install=addrtied:mapped:a1 line emitted between markindirectonly and mergeadjacent on both sides, post projection, verdict. The decisive contract is act=mergetype|res=0|exc=none plus verdict=PIPELINE-OK on both sides.
analysis_options.normalization: No normalization; both sides print the same projection of the same observation fields. The negative control (Rugra ActionMergeType reverted to the legacy merge_all) flips act=mergetype to exc=Cannot force merge of range and verdict to PIPELINE-THREW, proving the fixture discriminates the regression.
